stage1.title: Clinical Questionnaire
stage1.subtitle: Check all symptoms that apply. This generates a risk score out of 22 points.
stage1.metabolic: Has all three: Hypertension + Diabetes + Dyslipidemia
stage1.rigidity_desc: Muscle stiffness or resistance to movement
stage1.gait_desc: Shuffling walk, freezing, or difficulty walking
stage1.asymmetric_desc: One side of body more affected
stage1.constipation_desc: Chronic, not explained by other causes
stage1.bedridden_desc: Unable to get out of bed without help

stage2.title: Drawing Analysis
stage2.subtitle: Upload a hand-drawn spiral or wave pattern for CNN-based motor analysis.
stage2.spiral_desc: Archimedean spiral — best for PD detection
stage2.lighting_desc: Good lighting, camera directly above paper
stage2.pen_desc: Dark pen on plain white paper
stage2.drop_hint: or click to browse · PNG, JPG, WEBP
stage2.high_desc: Drawing patterns suggest high probability of motor impairment consistent with Parkinson's disease.
stage2.moderate_desc: Drawing shows some irregularities. Further evaluation may be warranted.
stage2.low_desc: Drawing patterns appear within normal range for this analysis.
stage2.heatmap_desc: Red = shaky / high-tremor strokes · Blue = smooth consistent strokes. Numbered circles mark the most irregular regions.
stage2.anomaly_desc: Regions where stroke direction changes most rapidly — a key indicator of motor irregularity.

combined.title: Final Assessment
combined.subtitle: Combines clinical score (35%) and drawing analysis (65%) into a final recommendation.
combined.incomplete_warning: Complete both Stage 1 and Stage 2 before generating the final assessment.
combined.disclaimer_body: This tool is for preliminary screening only and does not constitute a medical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified neurologist for proper evaluation.

about.title: About This Tool
about.subtitle: Research project — Parkinson's Disease prediction using MobileNetV2 + clinical scoring.
about.data_note: Data: 1,340 PD patient records — Udon Thani, Thailand (2567–2568 BE)
about.pdpa_body: This tool operates in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019) of Thailand. Health-related information — including symptom responses and hand-drawing images — constitutes sensitive personal data under Section 26 of the PDPA and is handled accordingly.
about.collected_body: Symptom questionnaire responses and hand-drawing images submitted voluntarily for screening purposes.
about.purpose_body: Preliminary Parkinson's disease risk screening and academic research. Data is not used for any commercial purpose.
about.retention_body: Submitted images and responses are processed in memory only and are not stored, logged, or retained on any server after the response is returned.
about.sharing_body: No personal data is shared with third parties. Aggregate anonymised results may be used for research publication.
about.consent_note: By using this tool you acknowledge that you have read this notice and voluntarily provide any data entered. Use of this tool implies consent to process the submitted data solely for the stated screening purpose.
about.disclaimer_body: This tool is for preliminary screening only and does not constitute a medical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for evaluation of Parkinson's disease.
